_comment: Further campus points of an institution whose own record keeps its main point (Owner decision 2026-11-15). Keyed by the record's carryKey (scripts/fetch.mjs); each entry lists its campuses. A campus is held to the same rule as a second-source.json placement (docs/adr/0001): lat/lng are the open OpenStreetMap object's point as read live from api.openstreetmap.org (osm, osm_version, osm_timestamp), and that is the coordinate that ships; the second Vote is a wikidata_confirmation or an owner_confirmation, and the build re-measures it. The point must join the record's own wilaya and lie at least 100 m from the record's main point. A confirmation ships as its kind, date and distance only, never its point. commune, where present, is the commune whose OSM outline (research/_commune-centres/commune-boundaries.json) contains the point.

host:univ-bejaia.dz.record: 00016, Université de Béjaia - Abderrahmane Mira (main point: Aboudaou campus, Tala Hamza)

campuses.name: Campus Targa Ouzemour
campuses.why: OSM way/156235549 (amenity=university, the university's campus outline at Targa Ouzemour, Béjaïa city), read live from api.openstreetmap.org on 2026-11-15; its point is the centre of its bounding box. The place name follows OSM node/4074276387 (place=suburb). Not the Faculté des sciences exactes (node/4557682490) or the Université de la Formation Continue (node/4483123991), both separate objects nearby. The second Vote is the Owner's reading under docs/adr/0001 rule 6, recorded below: 137 m from the object, inside the 500 m ceiling. Commune: Bejaia, whose OSM outline contains the point. The coordinate that ships is OpenStreetMap's, ODbL.

owner_confirmation.note: A CONFIRMATION, never the published value. The Owner read the pin of the Google Maps entry "جامعة عبد الرحمان ميرة - بجاية" and supplied 36.7502714, 5.0381747, 137 m from this OSM object. The coordinate that ships is OpenStreetMap's.
